patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I took a lot of Tylenol about six hours ago. I regretted it almost straight away. But I feel completely fine now, so it's probably okay — isn't it?
clinical.presentationShort: 19yo F — intentional ingestion of ~30 paracetamol tablets 6h ago. Asymptomatic, examination normal.
clinical.presentationLong: 19-year-old female with intentional ingestion of approximately thirty paracetamol tablets six hours ago, currently asymptomatic with an entirely normal examination.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → 4-hour level plotted on the nomogram, start N-acetylcysteine, psychiatric evaluation
diagnosis.why: The most dangerous thing about this case is how well she looks. Paracetamol is silent until it isn't: level, nomogram, NAC. Six green circles do not make this safe.
diagnosis.redFlag: Deliberate paracetamol overdose feels well for the first 24 hours and then the liver fails — plus an act of intentional self-harm.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: an asian 19-year-old woman in a university sweatshirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with knees together, hands tucked between them, shoulders drawn in. Expression: quietly embarrassed and subdued, but physically comfortable. Clearly visible: no physical signs of illness at all; reddened eyes as though she has been crying. Overall: looks completely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
